blocks.text: Enjoy mobile storage that works wherever you do. The Bush Business Furniture Series C 3 Drawer Mobile File Cabinet rolls smoothly on dual-wheeled, hooded casters for years of easy, everyday use. Slide the Cabinet under a coordinating Series C Desk to save space or move it around the office as needed. A single lock secures the bottom two drawers to protect your letter, legal and A4 files. The file drawer glides on smooth, full-extension ball bearing slides for an effortless reach to the back, and two box drawers store office supplies. Brushed Nickel hardware makes a lasting impression. The options are endless with Series C. This affordable commercial office furniture boasts quality craftsmanship, user-friendly features and 7 stylish finishes to blend seamlessly in any environment. Multiple layout options meet the needs of numerous workspaces, from the private or home office to reception areas and conference rooms. Affordably priced but built to last, this office furniture withstands the rigors of a 40-plus hour week and comes with a 10 Year Warranty. Series C evolves with your office and your preferences, allowing you to reconfigure your workspace as required with a complete line of coordinated products and accessories. American made with U.S. and imported parts.

items.label: OFFICE READY
items.value: The Series C Collection offers commercial quality desks and storage with professional style to meet the needs of any business. This Rolling File Cabinet is built for years of easy organization in home and corporate workplaces of all sizes.

items.label: BUILT TO LAST
items.value: Organize important paperwork inside a file cabinet with wheels that withstands the rigors of daily use in a busy professional environment. The finish resists scratches and stains to preserve the locking file cabinet's long-lasting appeal.

items.label: PRACTICAL FEATURES
items.value: Dual wheeled casters move the 3 drawer file cabinet wherever convenient storage is needed most, including underneath the desktop. Drawers can be locked to safeguard your letter, legal, and A4-size paperwork along with personal items.

items.label: A COMPLETE SOLUTION
items.value: Series C offers a variety of desk and storage options to complete your home or professional office with the same level of quality and style. Create your ideal workspace with a coordinating computer desk, storage cabinet, and bookcase.

items.label: TESTING AND WARRANTY
items.value: This commercial-grade filing cabinet has been meticulously designed and tested to meet ANSI/BIFMA quality standards for safety, durability, and performance and is backed by the Bush Business Furniture 10 Year Manufacturer's Warranty.
